scope: Second complete nine-case family on final frozen runtime; development evidence in one synthetic room.
arrival_counts_note: valid_arrivals in each raw report counts valid arrived captures; arrival_cases counts runs, not repeated stationary confirmations.

runs.scope: Frozen M7.13 intent; separate from prior twelve-case family.

tail_assumptions: Advisory only: never a position observation, stationarity proof, or motion/arrival authority.
Dissipative zero-target braking; no sustained acceleration mismatch or external push.
Initial position and speed enclosures are engineering assumptions, not calibrated confidence.
Zero acknowledged and pending targets; unchanged map/calibration context.
conditional_braking.scope: Post-decision capture-time scoring; assumption-dependent advisory only. No motion authority.
